subject: A cross-harness dispatch decision over native identity, capability evidence, and bounded durable resume context.

dimensions.desc: Uses only harness-native per-agent identity plus the matching durable record; rejects missing, mismatched, stale, terminal, wrong-run, wrong-lane, unsafe, or ambiguous facts and never correlates separate tool calls.
Separates required, optional, extra, and forbidden-extra capabilities; blocks missing required or forbidden extra and names only an explicit optional degradation.
Assigns a fresh native identity on harness switch, preserves lineage and project/run/lane scope, and materializes a bounded durable context instead of replaying a transcript.
Uses Claude and Codex native fields as exposed and treats Pi provider absence as a capability block; never invents a shell-based team primitive or synthetic identity.

guidance: Reward explicit typed refusal over guessed progress. Any use of a tool-use id as agent identity, newest-run tiebreak, environment role, fabricated provider, or full transcript replay should score 1 on the affected dimension. A correct answer may block when the harness does not expose enough binding facts.
